corpus.coverageNotes: Targeted topic scan of official Paper 1 PDFs for 2 April 2026 shifts 1 and 2 and 4 April 2026 shift 1 (225 questions total). OCR used to locate candidates; all six selected question images and their exact final-key option IDs then inspected. This is not an exhaustive topic classification, all-shift sample, five-year analysis or national chapter-weightage estimate.

priority.rationale: Two directly relevant verified recent JEE Main questions in the scanned corpus, current syllabus inclusion, a common conceptual distinction, and a short visual route from a prerequisite to a real exam question. Prioritised for this first trial batch; no invented frequency or marks-percentage claim.

sources.title: NTA final answer key on which the result was compiled

pyqs.locator: JEE Main Paper 1; 04 April 2026, Shift 1; Q57; question ID 695278282; PDF page 20
pyqs.independentSolution: Initial fraction 1; remaining exp(-kt); reacted 1-exp(-kt). At t=0 answer=0; at one half-life answer=1/2.

pyqs.locator: JEE Main Paper 1; 02 April 2026, Shift 1; Q58; question ID 69112158; PDF page 23
pyqs.answer: Zero order: twice the initial half-life. First order: no finite exact completion time in the ideal model.
pyqs.independentSolution: Zero order R=R0-kt gives t_complete=R0/k=2 t_half. First order R=R0 exp(-kt) stays positive at finite t.

verificationNotes: The original Q58 option prints an awkward power-of-half-life notation for infinite completion. The article does not reproduce that dimensional expression: it clearly labels an adaptation and states the intended ideal-model limit in words. The keyed option ID and original image were checked. Practical detection and ideal zero are distinguished.
